name: NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
benefit: - ₹200 per month for beneficiaries aged 60–79 years. - ₹500 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above. > **Note:** At present old age beneficiaries are getting anywhere between ₹200/- to ₹1000/- depending on the State Contribution.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household. 1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or above.
